mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 58 degrees and overcast at Reddan Soccer Park. The air quality index is at 51, we are in a third quarter moon phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will sit at 58 with rain predicted.

Verona officially welcomes Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the EMS team. Liz brings extensive experience in emergency operations and healthcare education to her new role. Also, a reminder that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles our refuse and recycling, so be sure to check their app for collection schedules and proper cart placement.

Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a packed slate with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
On October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open until 10 PM, making it the perfect time to stop by for a treat.
